ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense network of high-intensity linear streaks distributed across both lobes; larger contiguous high-intensity patches are mapped to the distal-ventral margins of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; the right distal lobe tip exhibits a jagged, multi-peaked profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature sweeping from the central notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned high-contrast linear pixel marks (rake marks) criss-crossing both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe coverage of linear rake marks across >50% of the surface; irregular/jagged distal tips indicating physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of overlapping linear abrasions creating a 'cross-hatched' visual texture.
